title: Home (Dashboard)
desc: Default landing page. Voucher-activity dashboard with date-range / currency / posted-status filters (auto-applied and remembered), per-type KPIs, data grids and switchable charts (column/line/area/pie/donut) for Journal, Cash Payment, Cheque Payment and Receipt vouchers, plus quick shortcuts to every system page.

title: Control Panel
desc: Primary control-panel dashboard with high-level operational widgets and summaries.

title: Activity Log
desc: Audit trail of user actions across the system, filterable for review.

title: Chart of Accounts
desc: Tree-based chart of accounts with inline add / edit / delete, branch and cost-center flags, search, and Excel import/export. Posting to parent (non-leaf) accounts is blocked.

title: Opening Balances
desc: Enter and import the opening debit/credit balances for accounts at the start of the fiscal year.

title: Link Groups to Accounts
desc: Associate account groups with their member accounts for grouped reporting.

title: Link Accounts
desc: Map/link accounts to system roles (e.g. cash, bank, customers, suppliers) used by automated postings.

title: Edit Account Name
desc: Bulk rename of account names (Arabic/English) with print support.

title: Clear Cost Centers
desc: Utility to clear/reset cost-center assignments on account movements.

title: Transfer Account Movements
desc: Move posted movements from one account to another.

title: Cost-Center Opening Balances
desc: Enter the opening balances per cost center.

title: Journal Vouchers (القيود اليومية)
desc: Create/edit general-ledger journal entries: date, serial type, currency, and balanced debit/credit lines with cost centers. Cannot save unless the entry balances (difference = 0).

title: Receipt Vouchers (سند قبض)
desc: Record cash/bank receipts from customers, debiting the cash/bank account and crediting the party.

title: Cash Payment Voucher (سند صرف نقدي)
desc: Record cash payments to suppliers/expenses.

title: Cheque Payment Voucher (سند صرف شيكات)
desc: Issue payment by cheque, generating the corresponding GL voucher and outgoing cheque.

title: Cheque Receipt Voucher (سند قبض شيكات)
desc: Receive payment by cheque, recording the incoming cheque and its GL voucher.

title: Journal Voucher Report
desc: List/print journal vouchers within a period with filters; clears results when filters change.

title: Account Belong Report
desc: Statement of an account and the accounts that belong to it (branched view).

title: Incoming Cheques (first entry)
desc: Register beginning/incoming cheques (number, bank, drawer, dates, amount, currency).

title: Outgoing Cheques (first entry)
desc: Register beginning/outgoing cheques.

title: Cheque Deposit
desc: Deposit incoming cheques to a bank account.

title: Cheque Collection
desc: Mark deposited cheques as collected/cleared.

title: Cheque Return
desc: Record returned (bounced) cheques.

title: Re-deposit Returned Cheques
desc: Re-deposit previously returned cheques.

title: Cheque Withdrawal
desc: Withdraw/cancel incoming cheques.

title: Cheque Endorsement
desc: Endorse incoming cheques to a third party.

title: Cheque Tracking
desc: Track the full movement history of a cheque by serial/number/value/date.

title: Detailed Account Statement
desc: Detailed ledger statement per account with opening balance, movements, cheques, aging and balance in words; deep-links to source vouchers.

title: Aging Analysis
desc: Receivables/payables aging buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-120, >120 days).

title: Trial Balance
desc: Trial balance for a period with debit/credit and balance columns.

title: Income Statement
desc: Profit & loss statement for the selected period.

title: Balance Sheet
desc: Statement of financial position (assets, liabilities, equity).

title: Accounts List Report
desc: Printable list of accounts up to a level, with clickable links to the chart of accounts.

title: Beginning Balances Report
desc: Report of opening balances per account.

title: Monthly Balances
desc: Account balances broken down by month.

title: Account Groups Report
desc: Balances aggregated by account group.

title: Cost-Center Account Balances
desc: Account balances per cost center, with optional estimated-balance columns and clickable cost-center links.

title: Cost-Center Transactions
desc: Detailed transactions per cost center, including the cost-center column.

title: Incoming Cheque Movement
desc: Movement statement for a selected incoming cheque, by serial type.

title: Inward Cheques (period)
desc: Incoming cheques received within a period.

title: Outward Cheques (period)
desc: Outgoing cheques issued within a period.

title: Cheques to Beneficiary
desc: Outgoing cheques issued to a specific beneficiary.

title: Payment Vouchers Report
desc: List of cheque payment vouchers (سندات الصرف) within a period.

title: Account Ledger (كشف حركات ورصيد حساب)
desc: Ledger for one account over a period: opening balance, movements with running balance, final balance; rows deep-link to vouchers and to the detailed statement (in a popup).

title: Missing / Unbalanced Vouchers
desc: Finds gaps in voucher numbering for a type (auto-fills min/max), and an unbalanced-transactions view for vouchers that don't net to zero.

title: Year-End Closing (الاقفال السنوي)
desc: Generates the year-end closing voucher that nets income-statement accounts into the P&L account, with a progress bar; supports deleting the closing entry.

title: Document Posting
desc: Post selected documents/ranges to the ledger.

title: Document Un-posting
desc: Reverse posting on selected documents.

title: Banks
desc: Define bank accounts used in cheque and payment operations.

title: Currencies
desc: Define currencies: number, Arabic/English name, exchange rate, decimal places and symbols.

title: Account Groups
desc: Define account groups for grouped reporting.

title: Cost Centers
desc: Define cost centers used to tag and analyze transactions.

title: Taxes
desc: Define tax types and rates.

title: Stamps
desc: Define stamp duties/fees.

title: Customers
desc: Customer master data for receivables.

title: Suppliers
desc: Supplier/vendor master data for payables.

title: Service Invoice (فاتورة خدمات)
desc: Create service-type invoices that auto-post to the general ledger.

title: Permissions
desc: User × permission matrix grouped by module. Grant/revoke fine-grained permissions; gated by Admin.ManagePermissions.

title: Company Info
desc: Company profile, decimals and branding used across the app.

title: Appearance
desc: Theme (light/dark), app theme and layout/direction settings.

title: Voucher Serials
desc: Define voucher serial/numbering types per voucher category.

title: Branches
desc: Define company branches.

title: Sales Invoices
desc: List of sales invoices with sorting, paging, view/print and (where allowed) delete and e-invoice transfer.

title: Add Sales Invoice
desc: Create a new sales invoice: customer, line items (qty, price, discount, tax).

title: Transfer Invoices
desc: Invoices pending transfer to e-invoicing (JoFawtara/Fotara) with QR generation.

title: Transferred Invoices
desc: Invoices already transferred to e-invoicing, with their QR codes.

title: Refunds
desc: Sales refund/credit documents.

title: Service Invoices
desc: List of service invoices.

title: Virtual Invoices
desc: List of virtual invoices.
